Fuzzes fd_gossip_msg_parse with libFuzzer initialization and input size limit.

# Purpose
This file defines the entry points for a libFuzzer target that tests `fd_gossip_msg_parse`. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) sets the runtime environment, starts the `fd` system with `fd_boot`, sets the log level for standard error, and registers `fd_halt` to run at exit. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) rejects input larger than `1232` bytes, creates a local `fd_gossip_view_t` object, and passes the input buffer to `fd_gossip_msg_parse` for parsing.
